product_metadata.title: Hamilton Beach TrueAir Plug-Mount Air Freshener Odor Eliminator for Common Household-Tobacco, Pet, Bathroom & Trash, On/Off Fan, with Carbon Filter + Green Meadow Cartridge, White (04530GM)
features: Quiet and Efficient: Quiet Fan Pulls in Unwanted Smells That Are Trapped and Neutralized by the Replaceable Carbon Filter, Bringing Fresh Air Back Into Your Home.
Fresh Scent: The Green Meadow Cartridge Offers a Light, Fresh Scent That Replaces Unwanted Odors.
Traps and Neutralizes Common Household Odors: Terrific for Eliminating Kitchen, Bathroom, Pet, and Tobacco Odors. Also Good for Workrooms and Trash Rooms.
Easy to Use: Simple On/Off Switch for Maximum Odor Elimination. Unit Plugs Directly Into Any 110 Volt Outlet.Do not use detergent, solvents, or spray cleaners
Eliminates Odors and Freshens Air for up to 3 Months: Includes Filter Replacement Indicator to Let You Know When It Is Time to Change the Filter.

Replacement Filters Available: Use Any Trueair Replacement Filter for Common Household, Pets, Tobacco or Green Meadow Scent Cartridge. Models Include 04230g, 04231gw, 04234g, 04290g, 04291g, 04294g and 04600.
description: Neutralize Odors: The Hamilton Beach TrueAir Odor Eliminator doesn’t mask pet smells, food and other odors, it eliminates them. The quiet fan pulls air through and the carbon filter, trapping and neutralizing odors before sending fresh air back into the room for about 3 months. The optional scent cartridge offers a light, fresh scent. Replacing your Hamilton Beach True Air filters is easy. Simply, place the filter in the unit, fitting the notched corner of the filter around notched edge of the odor eliminator.
